name: teachtown-runner
description: Rotates a TeachTown Social Skills group session: logs each student in, launches their activity on the big screen, waits while the group answers live, then moves to the next student. Humans answer all questions.

scripts.test: node --test test/subjects.test.js test/subjects.dom.test.js test/student-led-step1.test.js test/student-led-step1.dom.test.js test/home-status.test.js test/mac-menu.test.js
scripts.install-hooks: git config core.hooksPath teachtown-runner/hooks && echo "privacy pre-commit hook installed"
